suspendDialog.body: Suspending {name} fully locks its tenant dashboard and guest app — staff cannot log in and guests see an "unavailable" page. No data is deleted and the subscription is unchanged. Reactivation restores access immediately.

reactivateDialog.body: {name} regains access to its tenant dashboard and guest app immediately.
